note: Official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this guide was written. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and cites its sources; no guide text is copied from another guide. The game had not released when this guide was written, so where the official description is all that is known, the guide says so instead of inventing a location or step.
sources: PlayStation official trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — Grand Theft Auto VI
IGN GTA 6 Wiki

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands and activities, then collectibles and the big counts — and this pops last. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Gone Fishing to its end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. Story missions can be replayed from the pause menu, so it cannot be missed — just finish the mission. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); mission walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Nothing in a chapter trophy is missable — complete the missions in any order the story allows and it unlocks. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable — replay any mission you failed from the pause menu and keep going. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Do the stranger and activity trophies that open up along the way if you like, but the chapter itself only needs its story missions. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so by now you should also be most of the way through the activity and collectible counts. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and watch the credits roll; the gold trophy pops on completion. If a choice in the finale worries you, keep a manual save from before it — but the trophy itself only needs the mission finished, whichever way it ends. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); mission walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks as you play through the story and can be replayed if you fail it — no special preparation is needed. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); mission walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually the longer set-pieces, so stock up on ammo and armour before starting and use cover during the escape. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); mission walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every named story-mission trophy it pops on completion and is unmissable through mission replay. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); mission walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The name suggests a show or concert set-piece — follow the mission markers, complete its objectives, and the trophy pops at the end. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); mission walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Expect a vehicle or aircraft set-piece; bring a fast car for the getaway and keep moving once the alarm goes up. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); mission walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The title points to a large combat operation, so go in with full health, armour and a good rifle, and use the mission's checkpoints if a section goes wrong. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); mission walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Reach 100% in the game's completion checklist (pause menu stats): story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the counted challenges all feed into it. This is the last gold before the platinum — use this guide's roadmap and checklist to find whatever percentage is still missing. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); completion checklist: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the total, which the stats screen tracks. The fastest way is to chain small stunts while driving between missions instead of grinding them in one sitting. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); stunt list: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once — racing, fishing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest. If one type is missing from your stats, check the activities section of this guide: the unplayed type is usually the one you have not visited yet. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); activity list: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practice each weapon class until you know its recoil, then go for gold one challenge at a time — the range lets you retry instantly, so a failed run costs nothing. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); the count of 42 challenges: Exophase and PSNProfiles; challenge tips: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations around Leonida. Learn each course's corners first with a practice run, then race to win — the drone handles like a fast RC car, so brake early for tight turns. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); race locations: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race types across the map (street, off-road, boat and air if offered) and tick them off in this guide as you win them. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); race list: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing challenges are usually about landing the bigger catch or the most fish in the time limit — use the best rod and bait you can buy first. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); fishing guide: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at an arcade cabinet anywhere in Leonida. Any game counts — pick the shortest one, play it through to its end screen, and the trophy pops. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); arcade locations: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore and progress the story — check the map for Andy's icon whenever a new chapter opens. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); strand walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Keep an eye on the map for Kenton's marker between story chapters and play each mission as it appears. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); strand walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Like the other stranger strands, it opens up during the story — do its missions when they appear rather than leaving them all for the endgame. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); strand walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more than 8 strangers in the game, so pick the strands you enjoy — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each count toward this total. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); stranger list: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Randy's strand counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, so it is worth doing even if you are not chasing this trophy alone. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); strand walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Play Tyrone's missions as they unlock and the strand completes naturally during a thorough playthrough. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); strand walkthrough: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find every meditation spot in Leonida and meditate at each one. Meditation spots are scenic viewpoints — check the collectibles filter in this guide and clear them region by region so none is left behind. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); spot locations: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Unique hunts usually need you to follow tracks or clues to a specific animal — bring a scoped rifle, stay downwind and take the clean shot. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); hunting guide: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets by finding cards scattered across Leonida. Cards are a classic GTA collectible — grab them as you pass through each area and use a map checklist so you only revisit what you missed. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); card locations: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a pure count trophy — do it gradually while exploring, since the locations are spread over the whole map. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); location list: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's challenges — stunt, shooting, racing, fishing and more all count. This pops naturally while chasing the other count trophies; check the challenges menu to see which categories are closest to done. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); challenge list: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose the cops without either of you being caught. Break line of sight, switch to a fast car, and use alleys and tunnels to drop the search — it only counts if you escape together. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); wanted-level tips: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Plan a route of 3 close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); robbery guide: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — sit in or drive each new model you find and it counts. Vehicle variety is everywhere in Leonida, so this pops naturally if you try a new ride whenever you see one instead of always taking the same car. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); vehicle list: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a busy firefight, wait until enemies are grouped, then trigger it and chain the kills — a shotgun or SMG works best up close. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); combat tips: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — steal a plane and take off without clearance, or escape the airport in an unplanned vehicle. The trophy is about the airport moment itself, so do it when you are free to cause chaos there. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); airport guide: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank — get into a Rhino and cause mayhem with it. Tanks are rare and heavily guarded, so expect a big wanted level; the trophy is for the tank moment, not for surviving it. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); vehicle guide: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly, without ever being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses calling the police — and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, restart from a save and try a stealthier approach. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); heist guide: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault robberies are bigger jobs than shop robberies — plan the getaway vehicle first, then crack the vault and leave before the response arrives. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); heist guide: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads — block one, crack it open, grab the cash and get away before backup arrives. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape much easier. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); robbery guide: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida so the map is fully revealed. Drive, fly and sail through each area — the trophy tracks map coverage, so sweep the corners and islands you would otherwise never visit. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); map: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation run by each gang in Leonida. Each gang has its own operations — work through them gang by gang and tick them off in this guide so you know which gang is still untouched. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); gang operations: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. This is a quiet moment trophy — find the bar or beach spot on Ocean Drive, sit down with a drink, and it pops. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); location guide: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's window in the classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build up speed on the street outside, and smash out through it. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); location guide: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — bowl a full game there. The trophy is tied to that specific alley, so make sure you are at Kolt & Associates and not another bowling spot. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); location guide: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague, so this one is about a partnership moment — most likely a co-op activity with your partner that draws a crowd. Play the partner activities as they appear and it should pop; community guides will pin down the exact trigger once the game is out. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); community tracking: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — this trophy is tied to a story choice, and it pops when that choice is made. Keep a manual save before big story decisions so you can see the other outcome, but the trophy only needs the choice itself. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); story choices: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — this trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt at something, most likely retrying a failed mission or activity and clearing it. If a mission fails, retry it straight away rather than reloading an old save. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); community tracking: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — this is a secret or easter-egg moment, the kind of trophy that pops when something strange happens in the world. Explore off the beaten path, try the odd and the unusual, and check community guides once players have found the trigger. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); easter eggs: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Take out enemies with a melee weapon while driving past them — a melee drive-by. Find a slow stretch of road with pedestrians or enemies nearby, equip a bat or similar weapon, and swing as you pass at low speed. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); combat tips: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts — Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big score and the total builds up steadily. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); money guide: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — clothes, weapons, cars and food all count. Buy what you need for other trophies first and this pops on its own; the stats screen tracks total spending. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); shopping guide: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought through the in-game property or real-estate app — save up, then work through the list region by region and tick them off here. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); property list: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — drive a vehicle, open the app and register it. Any 10 distinct vehicles count, so register the ones you drive for other trophies as you go. Source: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles); app guide: GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com).
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: PlayStation official trophy list (via Exophase and PSNProfiles)
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com)
